## Fig C — Temporal Trajectory in Joint Lipid + Metabolite Space

*Each arrow represents one colony's movement through the first two PCs of combined lipid + metabolite space between consecutive timepoints. Displacement magnitude (inset) quantifies how much each species' metabolic state shifts per transition.*

```{r fig-C, fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
# Re-use pca_scores, pca_arrows, displacement objects built in Section 8d.

if (exists("pca_scores") && exists("pca_arrows")) {

  hull_data_c <- pca_scores %>%
    group_by(species, timepoint) %>%
    slice(chull(PC1, PC2)) %>%
    ungroup()

  p_traj <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(data = hull_data_c,
                 aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, group = timepoint, fill = timepoint),
                 alpha = 0.07, colour = NA) +
    geom_segment(data = pca_arrows,
                 aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, xend = PC1_end, yend = PC2_end),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.22, "cm"), type = "closed"),
                 linewidth = 0.7, colour = "grey30", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = pca_scores,
               aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = timepoint, shape = timepoint),
               size = 3.2, alpha = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ species, nrow = 1) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(TP1 = "#2166ac", TP2 = "#74add1",
                 TP3 = "#fdae61", TP4 = "#d73027"),
      name = "Timepoint") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(TP1 = "#2166ac", TP2 = "#74add1",
                 TP3 = "#fdae61", TP4 = "#d73027"),
      guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(TP1 = 16, TP2 = 17, TP3 = 15, TP4 = 18),
                       name = "Timepoint") +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", pct_var[1], "% variance)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", pct_var[2], "% variance)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))

  if (exists("displacement")) {
    p_disp <- displacement %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = transition, y = dist_moved, colour = species)) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
      stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.4,
                   colour = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
      facet_wrap(~ species, scales = "free_x") +
      scale_colour_manual(values = species_cols, guide = "none") +
      labs(x = "Timepoint transition", y = "PC displacement (Euclidean)") +
      theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
            strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold"))

    fig_C <- (p_traj / p_disp) +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(
        title    = "Fig C — Temporal trajectory in joint metabolic space",
        subtitle = "Arrows connect consecutive timepoints per colony; displacement = Euclidean distance in PC1–PC2"
      )
  } else {
    fig_C <- p_traj +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(title = "Fig C — Temporal trajectory in joint metabolic space")
  }

  fig_C

} else {
  message("Fig C: Run Section 8 (pca-scores-combined / trajectory-plot chunks) first to populate pca_scores and pca_arrows.")
}
```

```{r fig-E, fig.width=12, fig.height=5}
                        colour = species, group = species)) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line",  linewidth = 1.1) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "ribbon",
                 aes(fill = species), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = species_cols, name = NULL) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = species_cols,   name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    labs(title = "High-PUFA (≥4 double bonds) proportion",
         x = "Timepoint", y = "Proportion of lipid species") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  fig_E <- (p_ui | p_pufa4) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title    = "Fig E — Unsaturation Index and high-PUFA proportion over time",
      subtitle = "Line = species mean ± SE; individual points from colony-level means"
    )
  fig_E

} else {
  message("Fig E: Run Section 10 (lipidome-composition-setup chunk) first to populate ui_colony and lipid_unsat.")
}
```

## Integrated 5-panel summary

A single composite figure combining all five panels for manuscript or presentation use.

```{r integrated-summary, fig.width=18, fig.height=22}
# This block assembles Figs A–E if all required objects are present.
# Each figure is defined in its own chunk above; here we stack them with patchwork.

panels_ready <- c(
  A = exists("fig_A"),
  B = exists("p_net_acr") && exists("p_net_poc") && exists("p_net_por"),
  C = exists("fig_C"),
  D = exists("fig_D"),
  E = exists("fig_E")
)

cat("Panels ready:", paste(names(panels_ready)[panels_ready], collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Panels missing:", paste(names(panels_ready)[!panels_ready], collapse = ", "), "\n")

if (all(panels_ready)) {

  fig_B_panel <- (p_net_acr | p_net_poc | p_net_por) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title    = "Fig B — Metabolic integration network",
      subtitle = "Edges = FDR < 0.05 lipid class × metabolite pathway correlations"
    )

  (fig_A /
    fig_B_panel /
    fig_C /
    fig_D /
    fig_E) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      title      = "Integrated lipid–metabolite analysis — E5 coral species",
      tag_levels = "A",
      theme      = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
    ) +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1.1, 1, 1.4, 0.9, 0.9))

} else {
  message("Run all preceding sections in order before assembling the integrated summary.")
}
```
